richiami.difetto: Vehicles do not hold the necessary approval certification.
richiami.rimedio: Vehicles will be reworked to the approval standard and be VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) marked. This will include the fitment of e-marked lights/reflectors mirrors horn side stand and a compliant speedometer.The motor and motor controller will both be altered.
